acceptanceCriteria: DOGFOOD.md states where post-bind observations (check and seal deviations, reviewer findings) are recorded: the PR body only, a follow-up BUILD-LOG entry in the next change, or a reopened CEM.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 from the independent reviewer leg of V1-0146 (PR #102, extracted v0.7.0 build 46 archive, fresh clone at seal head 165e2d7). PR #102 deviations 5 and 6 and the whole reviewer leg could only be recorded in the PR body or in a later change, because no commit may follow the seal.
title: dogfood: observations made after the bind commit have no place in BUILD-LOG within the same change
